request.prompt: Use the licensed original photo as the sole identity and source-camera reference. Make a clean photorealistic catalog cutout of the SAME car, preserving paint color, exact body proportions, door/window layout, lamps, grille, wheels, mirrors, handles and visible trim/accessories. Keep the source camera, viewing direction and body style; do not mirror or invent an unseen opposite end. Clean dirt, scratches and surrounding-scene reflections. Remove environment, people, other vehicles, road, snow and advertising/plate characters. Keep realistic glass/interior and opaque bodywork. Show the COMPLETE car, all visible tires/mirrors and original roof accessories/antenna tips in a roomy frame with useful transparent space on all sides. True RGBA transparency, no floor/contact shadow, under-car reflection, glow, background fragments, captions, watermark or checkerboard. Do not add a shark fin or antenna type absent from the source. Do not infer engine specification or precise model year.  Keep the vehicle comfortably inside the frame with clearly visible transparent margins above every roof accessory, below every tire and beyond both ends; do not enlarge it up to the edges.  Preserve complete car/all visible tires/mirrors/roof rail and antenna tips with useful transparent room. Never copy neighboring-car/background parts. This exact BLUE/GREY car is ORIGINAL/PRE-FACELIFT SKODA OCTAVIA A5/II ORDINARY LIFTBACK, source2007 example. Preserve FOUR side doors/long sloped rearwindow/SHORT rear deck and original rearquarter/C-pillar, actual rear taillamp cluster/Skoda badge/bumper, source silver FIVE-SPOKE wheels/body-color mirrors/handles/side rubbingstrips. KEEP source near-SIDE REAR-SIDE camera nose RIGHT; do not rotate or invent an unseen front. NotCombi longcargo roof/Scout/RS and no roofrails/crossbars/fin invented. Source car is distant but full original detail is used, not a search thumbnail. Clean paint/reflections, remove ruin/building/fence/trees/pole/people/pavement and plate letters.
